import re
p = 'tests/base/test_orders.py'
s = open(p).read()

s = s.replace("import json\nimport zoneinfo\nfrom datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom zoneinfo import ZoneInfo\n",
              "import json\nimport zoneinfo\nfrom datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom unittest import mock\nfrom zoneinfo import ZoneInfo\n", 1)
s = s.replace("    OrderChangeManager, OrderError, _create_order, approve_order, cancel_order,\n    deny_order, reactivate_order, send_download_reminders,\n    send_expiry_warnings,\n)",
              "    OrderChangeManager, OrderError, _create_order, approve_order, cancel_order,\n    deny_order, expire_orders, mark_order_expired, reactivate_order,\n    send_download_reminders, send_expiry_warnings,\n)", 1)

s += '''

class OrderExpiryTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.o = Organizer.objects.create(name='Dummy', slug='dummy')
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            self.event = Event.objects.create(
                organizer=self.o, name='Dummy', slug='dummy',
                date_from=now() + timedelta(days=2),
                plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer'
            )
            self.event.settings.payment_term_weekdays = False

    def _order(self, code, expires=None, status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, event=None, **kwargs):
        return Order.objects.create(
            code=code, event=event or self.event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
            status=status, locale='en',
            datetime=now() - timedelta(days=10),
            expires=expires if expires is not None else now() - timedelta(hours=1),
            total=Decimal('46.00'),
            sales_channel=self.event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
            **kwargs
        )

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_expires_overdue_pending_order(self):
        order = self._order('A1')
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        order.refresh_from_db()
        assert order.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
        assert order.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.expired').exists()

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_keeps_order_with_future_deadline(self):
        order = self._order('A1', expires=now() + timedelta(days=1))
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        order.refresh_from_db()
        assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_keeps_non_pending_orders(self):
        paid = self._order('A1', status=Order.STATUS_PAID)
        canceled = self._order('A2', status=Order.STATUS_CANCELED)
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        paid.refresh_from_db()
        canceled.refresh_from_db()
        assert paid.status == Order.STATUS_PAID
        assert canceled.status == Order.STATUS_CANCELED

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_respects_disabled_automatic_expiry(self):
        self.event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
        order = self._order('A1')
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        order.refresh_from_db()
        assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_respects_per_event_setting(self):
        self.event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
        other = Event.objects.create(
            organizer=self.o, name='Other', slug='other',
            date_from=now() + timedelta(days=2),
            plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer'
        )
        other.settings.payment_term_weekdays = False
        disabled_order = self._order('A1')
        enabled_order = self._order('B1', event=other)
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        disabled_order.refresh_from_db()
        enabled_order.refresh_from_db()
        assert disabled_order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
        assert enabled_order.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_respects_expiry_delay(self):
        self.event.settings.payment_term_expire_delay_days = 3
        recent = self._order('A1', expires=now() - timedelta(hours=1))
        old = self._order('A2', expires=now() - timedelta(days=4))
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        recent.refresh_from_db()
        old.refresh_from_db()
        assert recent.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
        assert old.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_expires_when_last_payment_date_has_passed(self):
        self.event.settings.payment_term_expire_delay_days = 10
        self.event.settings.set('payment_term_last', now() - timedelta(days=1))
        order = self._order('A1')
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        order.refresh_from_db()
        assert order.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_skips_orders_that_must_not_expire(self):
        approval = self._order('A1', require_approval=True)
        valid = self._order('A2', valid_if_pending=True)
        with_fee = self._order('A3')
        OrderFee.objects.create(order=with_fee, fee_type=OrderFee.FEE_TYPE_CANCELLATION, value=Decimal('1.00'))
        expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        for order in (approval, valid, with_fee):
            order.refresh_from_db()
            assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_failure_on_one_order_does_not_stop_others(self):
        failing = self._order('A1')
        other = self._order('A2')
        real_mark_order_expired = mark_order_expired

        def flaky(order, *args, **kwargs):
            if order.pk == failing.pk:
                raise Exception('boom')
            return real_mark_order_expired(order, *args, **kwargs)

        with mock.patch('pretix.base.services.orders.mark_order_expired', side_effect=flaky):
            expire_orders(sender=self.event)
        failing.refresh_from_db()
        other.refresh_from_db()
        assert failing.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
        assert other.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
'''
open(p, 'w').write(s)
